title: Don't ship .duckdb files in package since format may change
description:
Fixes for duckdb 0.2.2

> We are trying to publish a new DuckDB version (0.2.2) on CRAN and with that new version, your package does no longer pass tests since the DuckDB database files are inside your package. We changed the on-disk database file format with this update (to be expected before we reach 1.0.0) and therefore the failing tests are not really surprising.
> 
> May I suggest that you ship the database within your package as a set of (CSV/PARQUET) files that are imported into DuckDB (IMPORT DATABASE) on startup for example? That would avoid such issues in the future. An easy way to do so is the EXPORT DATABASE command in DuckDB [1]. At the very least, could you confirm that you will update your package once DuckDB 0.2.2 is published on CRAN?
>
